Query the Ensembl REST API

Source: R/analysis_information.R
queryEnsembl.Rd

Query the Ensembl REST API

Usage

queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Character: API path

query

Character: API query

grch37

Boolean: query the Ensembl GRCh37 API? if FALSE, query the most recent API

Value

Parsed response or NULL if no response

Examples

path  <- "overlap/region/human/7:140424943-140624564"
query <- list(feature = "gene")
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
#>   assembly_name         source canonical_transcript        biotype
#> 1        GRCh37 ensembl_havana    ENST00000288602.6 protein_coding
#> 2        GRCh37        ensembl    ENST00000605989.1          snRNA
#>   seq_region_name              id                          logic_name
#> 1               7 ENSG00000157764 ensembl_havana_gene_homo_sapiens_37
#> 2               7 ENSG00000271932               ncrna_homo_sapiens_37
#>                                                                   description
#> 1 v-raf murine sarcoma viral oncogene homolog B [Source:HGNC Symbol;Acc:1097]
#> 2                               U6 spliceosomal RNA [Source:RFAM;Acc:RF00026]
#>   strand       end feature_type     start external_name version         gene_id
#> 1     -1 140624564         gene 140419127          BRAF       8 ENSG00000157764
#> 2      1 140583978         gene 140583872            U6       1 ENSG00000271932

path  <- "lookup/symbol/human/BRCA2"
query <- list(expand=1)
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
